scope.predicate: for every active D: (I intersection S_D is empty) OR (S_D subset_of I)

species_identity_rule: evaluate DON, NH4-N and NO3-N source-owned identities separately; aggregate to public N only after each identity is formed

owners.old_storage: for each X in {DiorNi,Nh,Ni}: sum complete enclosed S_D of SrWaMpOld(D)*CoMpX(D)
owners.new_storage: for each X in {DiorNi,Nh,Ni}: sum complete enclosed S_D of SrWaMp(D)*RsCoMpX(D)
owners.unsaturated_boundary: for each X: signed species-generic TpAm=AvCoML*FlMpVt(next)*St
owners.direct_drain: for each X: sum selected FlMpOuDrMp*AvCoMpX(1)*St
owners.FlMpOuDrSo: soil-routed internal path, no second external loss

public_aggregation: N = DON + NH4-N + NO3-N after separate identities

units.family: source N-family areic mass after concentration-times-areic-water transfer/storage
